| [0019](./0019/) | library | draft | - | not-started | 2026-08-20 — Re-split under the schemas/contracts convention, correcting the migration's core_schema: false. The entry DOES change opmodel.dev/core in three places, so core_schema flips to true and schemas/ is authored as a real core-schema delta: #CatalogEntry replacing the closed #Subscription with version and #transformers derived off the embedded #catalog, #Platform restated with the key-to-modulePath pattern constraint and both materialization slots turned into folds (D5); #TransformerContext plus #transform restated with the two metadata blocks projected from the other two inputs, #runtimeName the only runtime-owned field left (D12); #Component.metadata.resourceName restated with the validated instance-qualified default (D16). examples.cue makes the delta a test rather than a syntax check: derived version readout, enabled-only fold, reverse-index buckets, qualified default and its DNS ripple, override precedence, and the context projection including the label folds, each pinned by a hidden assertion; must-fail cases carry error text captured from cue v0.17.1 (stamp-versus-readout conflict, key-versus-import conflict, and the overlong-name refusal reported as `incomplete value` naming #NameType's constraints). spec.md pre-drafts the SPEC.md co-update for all three core slices in the four-part format. Two findings from writing the delta: (1) D16's hidden legibility assertion cannot be unconditional, because a component that authors an explicit short resourceName is legal even when the qualified concatenation would overflow, and CUE cannot detect from inside the value that the default was selected, so the core-resourcename-default slice must scope the assertion or restructure the cascade; recorded as a SKETCH at the field. (2) #Platform.#matchers loses its filler under D5 exactly as #composedTransformers does, but no decision says whether the reverse index stays derived on #Platform or moves into the render glue under D10; derived in the delta with the alternative recorded at the field. Re-measured on cue v0.17.1 while writing examples.cue: the unvalidated spelling exports a 67-rune name with cue export exiting 0, confirming D16's validated branch is load-bearing. contracts/contracts.cue keeps only the non-core material and its header, mirror section and cross-references are rewritten accordingly (the D5 registry shapes, the #ResourceNameDefault stub and the #Catalog/#TransformerMap/#NameType mirrors move to or are subsumed by schemas/). 02-design.md's core bullets refreshed: they still described the pre-revision D5 and framed D12 as conditional on OQ5. One committed mojibake line in 02-design.md (a double-encoded em-dash and two apostrophes, line 64) repaired. | Kernel render path parity with pure CUE |

## Status legend

- **draft** — initial design, actively being written
- **accepted** — design agreed upon, ready for implementation
- **implemented** — design has been realized in code
- **superseded** — replaced by a newer enhancement (see `superseded_by` in the entry's config.yaml)
